title: InstanceRegistryRecord
description: One record per Vast instance, kept on the homelab by the bot and the watchdog (spec 7.1). Never committed with real data.

vast_instance_id.description: null only while creating, or gone for a create that never reached Vast

created_at.description: epoch UTC seconds on the homelab clock

vast_start_date.description: Vast's own start timestamp, the independent source for the hard cap

start_stuck_at.description: epoch UTC seconds when the web found the start stuck (the container never started) and released the instance

stuck_machine_id.description: Vast machine id of that stuck start; the next Starts avoid it for VAST_BAD_MACHINE_TTL_MIN
